nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: POST { postId, query }  or  { posts: [ { postId, query }, ... ] }. Called from Claude during drafting, and by the Image Resolver as a fallback rung.

nodes.name: Google Images (SerpApi)
nodes.notes: Uses the existing SerpApi credential, which appends api_key as a query param.

nodes.name: Pick Best Result
nodes.notes: Takes the first result that is https, big enough, and not from a host that blocks hotlinking. Keeps the source page URL for provenance.

nodes.name: Upload To Cloudinary
nodes.notes: Cloudinary fetches the remote image and re-hosts it permanently. Provenance (source page + site) is stored on the asset as context metadata.
